# Resizable

Panels people resize by dragging the line between them.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Multi-brand</span> Resizable suits desktop tools where people size panels, not phones. Multi-brand avoids tools staff use all day, and customers sign up on phones. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./sidebar">Sidebar</a>, <a href="./sheet">Sheet</a></span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-resizable--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Resizable examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-resizable--docs">Open Resizable in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-resizable--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Desktop tools where people choose how much space each panel gets.
- **Not when:** Phones, or layouts with one obvious shape.

Instead:

- [Sidebar](./sidebar.md): Fixed app navigation.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | The handle can be focused and moved with arrow keys. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add resizable
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Resizable reads 7 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Resizable's tokens to change Resizable alone.
